Win round four of [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
*Win the fourth round of the Norn fighting tournament.

===Reward===
:''No quest reward''
*You gain 20 [[Norn Reputation Point]]s for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
*You gain a quest reward after beating all 6 rounds, see [[Final Round: Fight!]] (first time completion) or [[Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!]] (for repeated victories)

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Magni the Bison
:''"'''[Solo Quest]''' Some of you [[human]]s are not as weak as you seem. But if you seek to prove that you're more than the scruffy-looking cub I see before me, then defeat your '''fourth round opponent'''."''

===Intermediate dialogue===
:(The dialogue depends on which opponent you are facing. See [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for the dialogue and quotes.)

==Notes==
*Round four opponents may be [[Eve]], the [[Ghostly Hero (PvE)|Ghostly Hero]], [[Headmaster Vhang]], [[Kahmu]], [[Koss]], [[Morgahn]], or [[Razah]]. Please refer to [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for details on their skill sets.
*This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 3 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 4 opponent and the follow-up quest [[Round 5: Fight!]] is automatically accepted.
